description: Lists the types the site's detectors use, grouped by category (face, eye, lip, nose): each with slug, name, page URL and how many of the 102 reference faces it covered (count and share), plus the category hub page. Use this to discover valid slugs or to compare types within a category; use get_face_type instead when you already know the slug and need its definition and threshold rule. The split shows how the detector divides these faces, not how common a type is in a population. Read-only; returns every type in the category, no paging.

category.description: face (face shapes), eye, lip or nose types. Omit to list all four categories.

name: list_face_types
title: List face, eye, lip and nose types
